pathAssistantSteps.info: Condition assessment delivered. Hand the opinion back to the deal team.
Assess roof, structure, HVAC / MEP, parking, and envelope. Note any additional work, upgrades, and code / compliance concerns, and set an overall condition rating.
Estimate the cost to address the roof, MEP, upgrades, and any additions.
Commercial deal forwarded for a construction condition assessment. Schedule the site visit.
Summarize the condition findings and cost impact, set the Go / Conditional / No-Go recommendation, note any conditions and timeline impact, and record the delivery date.
Schedule and complete the on-site visit. Capture access notes and photos, and record who performed the visit.
